reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Migration 0001_create_attendance_schema.sql L67 defines the RLS policy on attendance.temp_registrations as `FOR SELECT USING (true)`, and fix_security_permissions.sql L87 explicitly grants SELECT to the anon role; the table is added to supabase_realtime publication in 0002. Therefore any unauthenticated client who obtains the QR token (e.g., by photographing the kiosk screen) can open a Realtime channel and receive every UPDATE event for that row, leaking accessed_at timestamps and is_used state. An attacker can trigger this via the public Supabase Realtime endpoint by subscribing with the public anon key to `kiosk-qr-channel-<stolen-token>`, causing real-time information disclosure of the victim's temp registration usage state.
